output.reason: The linked PR [ev-5f600c2dbe2c] says the APIEstablisher now merges the desired spec into the existing MRD, so it "never inadvertently changes MRD states except when explicitly setting them to Active". This keeps externally managed MRD state as it is. It does not, as proposed, let provider definitions newly modify existing MRDs. The change touches only the establisher code [ev-01b9844c8d60]. The same release introduces the MRD type and its reconcilers [ev-47653e3e1ebb] [ev-543a22471270], so this is a fix inside the release, not something an upgrading operator must act on or review. The consequence is none (informational).

correction.statement: In Crossplane 2.0.0 the package APIEstablisher merges a provider's desired MRD spec into the existing MRD instead of overwriting it. It no longer changes MRD state by accident and only sets state when making an MRD Active. This is a fix to MRD handling, which is new in this release, and it needs no operator action.

consequence.statement: No operational consequence. When a provider's MRDs are applied, existing MRD state that was set externally is kept rather than changed by accident. The establisher changes MRD state only when it explicitly sets an MRD to Active. MRDs are introduced in this same release.
